paras: The northern shriketit (Falcunculus whitei) is a species of bird in the family Falcunculidae. It is found in the Kimberley region of north-western Australia and the Top End of the Northern Territory.
This bird is sometimes considered to be a subspecies of the eastern shriketit (F. frontatus), often lumped with it and the western shriketit (F. leucogaster).
